notes.title: Minor improvements and fixes
notes.content:
- Added effects to highlight the Melee and Mech ability.
- Added effect to indicate reload.
- Changed how Anomaly works/looks.
- Added some sound effects to Anomaly.
- Fixed bug with speed being dropped to 0 after anomaly event.

notes.title: Game modes added
notes.content:
Added 2 game modes: Run and Freeplay.
  -In Run mode, the player has to go through all levels without losing any rounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871066/62da4bbb57a32d79b0061d00b3bbc009068bc024.png
  -Losing a round results in a lost run.
  -There will be multiple save opportunities.
 All levels discovered in Run will be available in Freeplay mode.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871066/73e813bc331da462b2e1e1c4c49d9b884c58056a.png
  -In Freeplay, players can replay any level discovered in Run mode to practice for a new run.
  -All points received during Freeplay and Run are now persisted and can be viewed in the Hiscores menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871066/98c4fbf8a0cca7ac783a7a06caf46d00036331e5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871066/89db5956252d57f433f309565cffbe37409a7c85.png
  -It will be possible to buy new Robots/Pilots with these points in the future.
 Bug fixes:
  -On-screen overlapping messages result in the inability to finish the level.
  -Points for enemies were not calculated correctly.
 Inventory system refactoring.

notes.title: Multiple improvements.
notes.content:
Level 3 added.
 New obstacle type added called Static Field:
      Projectiles can pass through it, unlike player or enemy.
      All projectiles will be slowed down while passing through the static field.
      Only standard projectiles can pass through the static field.
 Changed controls for Operator ability. Much easier to navigate and aim now.
 Added collision detection between player and enemy projectiles:
      A black hole spawns on collision.
      It pulls all enemies and players that are in its detection field.
      The black hole despawns in 5 seconds.
 Anomaly will now decrease the speed of all enemies and players for the duration of its effect.

notes.title: Minor UI and audio fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed mouse cursor being visible in-game.
- Fixed default audio level - reduced from 80 to 50.
- Settings buttons shifted.
